_doc: Gardens and rain catchers (ADR-0049, src/building/farming.gd). Times are game minutes or days. A bed holds 0..capacity of soil moisture; a catcher holds bottles' worth of water (units).

soil._doc: capacity: a soaked bed. dry_per_day: what bare soil loses a day; crop_use_per_day: what each living plant drinks on top; hot_dry_per_c: +x per degree over hot_from_c. rain_fill_minutes: minutes of full rain that soak a dry bed.

plants._doc: recover_per_day: health a watered plant regains. frost_kill_days: days of frost that kill a healthy plant. wilted_below: health under which it shows wilted.

temperature._doc: Growth rises from the crop's min_temp_c to best_c, holds to hot_c and falls off past it.

water_sources._doc: What waters a bed, in the order chosen when nothing suitable is held (clean water last: you drink that).

catcher._doc: fill_per_hour: units an hour in full rain (snow_fill_per_hour in snow). containers: empty item -> [full item, units it takes], in the order they are filled. drink: one mouthful of rain water (murky: boil a bottle to be safe).
